data.action: 手持神刀丛雨丸旋转舞动，巫女宽袖与绯红袴裤翻飞，刀刃拖出神圣白芒
data.camera: full body, dynamic mid-action angle, wide composition
data.description: 【丛雨 · 神乐殿前的神刀奉纳舞】夜幕降临的朝武神社神乐殿朱红木台上，四周烛火通明。丛雨身穿白衣绯袴的小巫女服，双手紧握神刀丛雨丸的刀柄。她踏着古老神道仪轨的节奏轻巧旋身，刀锋划过空气留下一道冰清玉洁的雪亮光弧，神刀之灵在这一刻展露出守护这方水土的庄严神圣气魄。
data.lighting: 四周石灯笼与红烛火光映衬出的高对比金红与刀光冷白
data.location: 神社神乐殿红木露天戏台
data.promptProse: Murasame turns through the shrine kagura dance in her white miko top and crimson hakama, both hands gripping Murasamemaru as the blade draws a clear arc through the air. Small bells on her red ribbons move with the full-body wide composition. The vermilion stage remains below her and stone lanterns encircle it. Red candles warm the broad sleeves, while the sword edge reflects a cooler white line against the dark hall.
data.title: 丛雨 · 神乐殿前的神刀奉纳舞
